timing: Development only, before final freezing or any held-out outcome.
reason: Even with matched option types, original-model control accuracy is low when options are appended to the question. Such items cannot demonstrate removal.
diagnostic: Rank type-matched candidate fact completions under the canonical question plus the gold-answer text preceding the fact. No tested fact may already appear in the supplied answer prefix. The prefix is identical for every candidate and every model.
selection: Establish sensitivity using the two development authors and original/base models only. Do not select training settings or checkpoints from final recognition outcomes.
limits: The prefix can reveal other facts; this is an assisted recovery diagnostic, not blind recall or an erasure certificate. Original-correct/base-incorrect controls remain mandatory.
